entities.name: Identification procedure
entities.description: Network-initiated procedure used to request the UE to provide specific identification parameters such as identity or capabilities.

entities.name: IDENTITY REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the network to the UE to request specific identity information.

entities.name: IDENTITY RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to the network in response to an IDENTITY REQUEST, containing the requested identity information.

entities.name: Identity type
entities.description: Information element included in IDENTITY REQUEST message indicating the type of identity requested (e.g., IMSI, IMEI).

entities.name: Mobile identity
entities.description: Information element included in IDENTITY RESPONSE message containing the actual identity information requested by the network.

relations.description: The identification procedure includes sending an IDENTITY REQUEST message from network to UE.
The identification procedure includes receiving an IDENTITY RESPONSE message from UE to network.
IDENTITY REQUEST message contains the identity type information element.
IDENTITY RESPONSE message contains the mobile identity information element.
